def invoke(arguments, timeout=50):
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    return {'arguments': arguments, 'exit': result.returncode,
        'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}

    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    receipt = {'proof_inventory': {str(p.relative_to(work)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for p in sorted((work / 'proof').iterdir())}, 'production_edited': False}
    parent = None

        receipt['runtime'] = {'url': url, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        assert receipt['runtime']['sha256'] == 'c734ba335498892ecabdf5722526d945e25f41a09cd6d619b72bc20bec60f852'
        runtime = work / 'runtime'
        runtime.mkdir()
        with tarfile.open(archive) as packed:
            packed.extractall(runtime, filter='data')
        java_paths = list(runtime.glob('*/bin/java'))
        assert len(java_paths) == 1
        java = java_paths[0]
        receipt['java_version'] = invoke([str(java), '-version'])
        classes = work / 'classes'

        receipt['compile'] = invoke([str(java.with_name('javac')), '--release', '27', '-d', str(classes),
            str(work / 'proof/LinuxProcessTree.java'), str(work / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java')])
        assert receipt['compile']['exit'] == 0
        membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
        parent = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / membership.lstrip('/') / ('owner-package-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        parent.mkdir()
        receipt['parent'] = str(parent)
        arguments = [str(java), '--enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED', '-Djava.io.tmpdir=' + str(work),
            '-cp', str(classes), 'NaturalCompletionGate', str(classes), str(work / 'fixture'),

            print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import urllib.request
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse
import uuid
from native import invoke


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    manifest = json.loads((work / 'module-manifest.json').read_text())
    modules = work / 'modules'
    owner = modules / manifest['owner']['name']
    assert hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == manifest['owner']['sha256']
    for dependency in manifest['dependencies']:
        destination = modules / dependency['name']
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(dependency['url'], destination)
        assert hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == dependency['sha256']
    source = (work / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java').read_text()
    marker = '        classes = Path.of(args[0]);'
    assert source.count(marker) == 1
    source = source.replace(marker, marker + '\n        System.out.println("owner_module=" + LinuxProcessTree.class.getModule().getName());')
    sources = work / 'module-driver-source'
    sources.mkdir()
    (sources / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java').write_text(source)
    classes = work / 'module-driver-classes'
    classes.mkdir()
    java = next((work / 'runtime').glob('*/bin/java'))
    flags = ['--module-path', str(modules), '--add-modules', 'com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling',
        '--add-exports', 'com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling/com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.scheduler=ALL-UNNAMED']
    receipt = {'manifest': manifest, 'driver': source, 'scope': 'Actual named-module owner and classpath helper from the same tooling JAR.'}
    parent = None
    try:
        receipt['compile'] = invoke([str(java.with_name('javac')), '--release', '27', *flags,
            '-d', str(classes), str(sources / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java')])
        assert receipt['compile']['exit'] == 0
        original = json.loads((work / 'native-receipt.json').read_text())
        membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
        parent = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / membership.lstrip('/') / ('owner-module-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        parent.mkdir()
        receipt['parent'] = str(parent)
        identity = original['workload_identity']
        arguments = [str(java), '--enable-native-access=com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling',
            '-Djava.io.tmpdir=' + str(work), *flags, '-cp', str(classes), 'NaturalCompletionGate',
            str(owner), str(work / 'module-fixture'), str(work / 'workload.py'), '/usr/bin/python3',
            str(identity['uid']), str(identity['gid']), str(parent)]
        receipt['run'] = invoke(arguments)
        result = receipt['run']
        assert result['exit'] == 0
        assert 'owner_module=com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling' in result['stdout']
        origin = next(line.split('=', 1)[1] for line in result['stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith('owner_origin='))
        parsed = urlparse(origin)
        assert parsed.scheme == 'file' and parsed.netloc == '' and Path(unquote(parsed.path)) == owner
        assert all(marker in result['stdout'] for marker in ['root0_adopted_exit=0', 'root0_natural_cleanup=passed', 'natural_gate=passed'])
        receipt['status'] = 'passed'
    except BaseException as failure:
        receipt['status'] = 'failed'
        receipt['failure'] = {'type': type(failure).__name__, 'message': str(failure)}
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if parent is not None and parent.exists():
                (parent / 'cgroup.kill').write_text('1')
                for directory in sorted((p for p in parent.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()), reverse=True):
                    directory.rmdir()
                parent.rmdir()
            receipt['parent_removed'] = parent is None or parent.exists() is False

"""Self-expiring workload fixture; process ownership is implemented only by Java."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def report(destination):
    membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip()
    pending = Path(destination).with_suffix('.pending')
    pending.write_text(
        f'pid={os.getpid()}\nuid={os.getuid()}\ngid={os.getgid()}\n'
        f'groups={os.getgroups()}\npgid={os.getpgrp()}\n'
        f'cgroup={membership}\ntoken={os.environ.get("OWNER_GATE_TOKEN", "missing")}\n')
    os.replace(pending, destination)


if sys.argv[1] == 'natural-leaf':
    report(sys.argv[2])
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
    while not Path(sys.argv[3]).exists():
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            os._exit(124)
        time.sleep(0.01)
    os._exit(int(sys.argv[4]))
elif sys.argv[1] == 'natural-root':
    report(sys.argv[2])
    subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, __file__, 'natural-leaf', sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[6]],
                     start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
    os._exit(int(sys.argv[5]))
elif sys.argv[1] == 'leaf':
    report(sys.argv[2])
    time.sleep(20)
else:
    report(sys.argv[2])
    subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, __file__, 'leaf', sys.argv[3]],
                     start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
    os._exit(7)

import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

REPOSITORY = 'holdmyspot-com/codex-unleashed'
RUNS = 'repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/workflows/runner-debug-smoke.yml/runs?branch=main.new&event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=20'


def api(path):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', path], text=True))


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    phase = sys.argv[2]
    if phase == 'run':
        before = set(json.loads((work / 'runs-before.json').read_text()))
        candidates = [r for r in api(RUNS)['workflow_runs'] if r['id'] not in before]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            print('awaiting dispatched workflow identity')
            return 75
        if len(candidates) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError('Dispatched run identity is ambiguous')
        run = candidates[0]
        assert run['head_sha'] == '363089634f1cfd399e4a609243aed0db949a754b'
        (work / 'live-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(run, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('dispatched run', run['id'], run['status'])
        return 0
    if phase == 'artifact':
        run = json.loads((work / 'live-run.json').read_text())
        artifacts = api('repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/runs/' + str(run['id']) + '/artifacts')['artifacts']
        candidates = [a for a in artifacts if a['name'].startswith('runner-debug-Linux-X64-')]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            print('awaiting live connection artifact for', run['id'])
            return 75
        assert len(candidates) == 1
        artifact = candidates[0]
        packed = subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', 'repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/artifacts/' + str(artifact['id']) + '/zip'])
        (work / 'connection.zip').write_bytes(packed)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(packed)) as archive:
            assert archive.namelist() == ['connection.json']
            (work / 'connection.json').write_bytes(archive.read('connection.json'))
        (work / 'live-artifact.json').write_text(json.dumps(artifact, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('retrieved live connection artifact', artifact['id'])
        return 0
    assert phase == 'start'
    (work / 'runs-before.json').write_text(json.dumps([r['id'] for r in api(RUNS)['workflow_runs']]))
    inputs = {'target': 'x86_64-unknown-linux-musl', 'public_key': (work / 'client-key.pub').read_text().strip()}
    dispatched = subprocess.run(['gh', 'workflow', 'run', 'runner-debug-smoke.yml', '--repo', REPOSITORY,
        '--ref', 'main.new', '--json'], input=json.dumps(inputs), text=True, capture_output=True)
    (work / 'dispatch.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs': inputs, 'exit': dispatched.returncode,
        'stdout': dispatched.stdout, 'stderr': dispatched.stderr}, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert dispatched.returncode == 0, dispatched.stderr
    waiter = '/home/gili/codex-unleashed/home/.codex/plugins/cache/cat/cat/1.0/bin/wait-until'
    for check_phase in ['run', 'artifact']:
        command = shlex.join([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(work), check_phase])
        result = subprocess.run([waiter, '--check', command, '--deadline', '5m'])
        assert result.returncode == 0, check_phase
    print('Starting SSH immediately for run', json.loads((work / 'live-run.json').read_text())['id'], flush=True)
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(work / 'client.py'), str(work)])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pty
import re
import select
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    details = json.loads((work / 'connection.json').read_text())
    arguments = shlex.split(details['sshCommand'])
    arguments[1:1] = ['-tt', '-i', str(work / 'client-key'),
        '-o', 'IdentitiesOnly=yes', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes',
        '-o', 'UserKnownHostsFile=' + str(Path('.github/actions/debug-failed-runner/known_hosts').resolve())]
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    child = subprocess.Popen(arguments, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)
    transcript = open(work / 'ssh-transcript', 'ab', buffering=0)
    buffer = b''
    connected = False
    active = None
    completed = 0
    try:
        while child.poll() is None:
            readable, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
            if readable:
                try:
                    data = os.read(master, 65536)
                except OSError:
                    break
                if data == b'':
                    break
                transcript.write(data)
                buffer += data
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)', b'', buffer)
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', plain)
            if connected is False and re.search(rb'[$#] ?$', plain):
                connected = True
                (work / 'connected').write_text(str(child.pid))
                print('authenticated shell ready', flush=True)
                buffer = b''
            if active is not None and re.search(rb'\r?\n' + re.escape(active['marker'].encode()) + rb'\r?\n', plain):
                (work / f'result-{completed}.json').write_text(json.dumps(active))
                print('command completed', completed, flush=True)
                completed += 1
                active = None
                buffer = b''
            queue = work / 'commands.json'
            if connected and active is None and queue.exists():
                commands = json.loads(queue.read_text())
                if len(commands) > completed:
                    active = commands[completed]
                    payload = (active['command'] + '\n').encode()
                    while payload:
                        count = os.write(master, payload)
                        payload = payload[count:]
        status = child.wait()
        (work / 'ssh-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit': status, 'completed': completed}))
        print('ssh exited', status, flush=True)
        return status
    finally:
        transcript.close()
        os.close(master)
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.terminate()
            child.wait()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import urllib.request
import uuid


def invoke(arguments, timeout=50):
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    return {'arguments': arguments, 'exit': result.returncode,
        'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr}


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    receipt = {'proof_inventory': {str(p.relative_to(work)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for p in sorted((work / 'proof').iterdir())}, 'production_edited': False}
    parent = None
    try:
        uid = int(os.environ['SUDO_UID'])
        gid = int(os.environ['SUDO_GID'])
        assert uid > 0 and gid > 0
        receipt['workload_identity'] = {'uid': uid, 'gid': gid}
        archive = work / 'jdk.tar.gz'
        url = 'https://cdn.azul.com/zulu/bin/zulu27.30.107-ca-jdk27.0.1-linux_x64.tar.gz'
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, archive)
        receipt['runtime'] = {'url': url, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        assert receipt['runtime']['sha256'] == 'c734ba335498892ecabdf5722526d945e25f41a09cd6d619b72bc20bec60f852'
        runtime = work / 'runtime'
        runtime.mkdir()
        with tarfile.open(archive) as packed:
            packed.extractall(runtime, filter='data')
        java_paths = list(runtime.glob('*/bin/java'))
        assert len(java_paths) == 1
        java = java_paths[0]
        receipt['java_version'] = invoke([str(java), '-version'])
        classes = work / 'classes'
        classes.mkdir()
        receipt['compile'] = invoke([str(java.with_name('javac')), '--release', '27', '-d', str(classes),
            str(work / 'proof/LinuxProcessTree.java'), str(work / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java')])
        assert receipt['compile']['exit'] == 0
        membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
        parent = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / membership.lstrip('/') / ('owner-package-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        parent.mkdir()
        receipt['parent'] = str(parent)
        arguments = [str(java), '--enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED', '-Djava.io.tmpdir=' + str(work),
            '-cp', str(classes), 'NaturalCompletionGate', str(classes), str(work / 'fixture'),
            str(work / 'workload.py'), shutil.which('python3'), str(uid), str(gid), str(parent)]
        receipt['run'] = invoke(arguments)
        assert receipt['run']['exit'] == 0
        for marker in ['root0_adopted_exit=0', 'root0_natural_cleanup=passed', 'natural_gate=passed']:
            assert marker in receipt['run']['stdout'], marker
        receipt['status'] = 'passed'
    except BaseException as failure:
        receipt['status'] = 'failed'
        receipt['failure'] = {'type': type(failure).__name__, 'message': str(failure)}
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if parent is not None and parent.exists():
                (parent / 'cgroup.kill').write_text('1')
                for directory in sorted((p for p in parent.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()), reverse=True):
                    directory.rmdir()
                parent.rmdir()
            receipt['parent_removed'] = parent is None or parent.exists() is False
        finally:
            (work / 'native-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    source = (work / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java').read_text()
    marker = '        classes = Path.of(args[0]);'

    sources = work / 'module-driver-source'

    (sources / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java').write_text(source)

    classes.mkdir()
    java = next((work / 'runtime').glob('*/bin/java'))
    flags = ['--module-path', str(modules), '--add-modules', 'com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling',
        '--add-exports', 'com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.tooling/com.holdmyspot.codexunleashed.scheduler=ALL-UNNAMED']
    receipt = {'manifest': manifest, 'driver': source, 'scope': 'Actual named-module owner and classpath helper from the same tooling JAR.'}
    parent = None
    try:
        receipt['compile'] = invoke([str(java.with_name('javac')), '--release', '27', *flags,
            '-d', str(classes), str(sources / 'NaturalCompletionGate.java')])
        assert receipt['compile']['exit'] == 0
        original = json.loads((work / 'native-receipt.json').read_text())
        membership = Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1]
        parent = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / membership.lstrip('/') / ('owner-module-' + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        parent.mkdir()

            str(owner), str(work / 'module-fixture'), str(work / 'workload.py'), '/usr/bin/python3',
            str(identity['uid']), str(identity['gid']), str(parent)]

                    directory.rmdir()
